title: F3 SD Card Health Check Error Blocks Leaderboard
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f3:card error_blocks=*
| stats sum(error_blocks) as total_value, avg(error_blocks) as avg_value by card_label
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks card label values by total and average error blocks across F3 SD card health check events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `error_blocks` values for each F3 SD card health check event and review total and average error blocks by card label.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total error blocks.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which card label shows the biggest error blocks numbers in your F3 SD card health check data.
